yaml.title: The system behind the atlas
yaml.subtitle: A digital atlas for your botanical collection

markdown.markdown:
```{=html}
Arboretum Home The Collection Map Self-guided tour Wellbeing Visit Sponsor a tree Donate Companies Contact Book a visit Español ▸
``` This site is not just a web page: it is the **public interface of a scientific database**. Behind it runs a simple, powerful system — *you maintain the information once and everything else is generated automatically*. We developed and applied this system at the Arboretum of Estancia La Constancia, and it can be replicated for **other botanical collections**. Many gardens, nurseries and reserves have their information scattered across spreadsheets, folders and photos. This system unifies it into a single database and, from it, automatically generates: ::: grid ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} ### Interactive map Location of each specimen, trails and sectors. ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} ### Species profiles One page per specimen, with no coding. ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} ### 📖 Catalogue with filters Search by family, origin and group. ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} ### Statistics Recalculated automatically with every update. ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} ### 🔗 QR labels One code per tree that opens its profile. ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} ### 🔄 Automatic publishing You update the database and the site rebuilds itself. ::: ::: ## Who it's for Botanical gardens, arboreta, nurseries, municipalities, nature reserves, universities and **estates** that want to document and showcase their natural heritage in a professional way, sustainable over time. ## Why it works in the long run - **Low maintenance:** a single spreadsheet feeds the whole site. - **No daily technical dependency:** you don't need a programmer to load data. - **Scalable:** it works the same for 50 or for 5,000 specimens. - **Scientific and educational value:** the database supports research, conservation and outreach. ## Let's talk Do you have a collection you'd like to bring to a digital atlas like this one? Write to us and we'll arrange a demonstration: - Email: [laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com](mailto:laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com) - 📱 WhatsApp: [+54 9 11 5736 0940](https://wa.me/5491157360940) --- *See a real example in action: explore the [Arboretum of La Constancia](index.html).*
